issue-authoring-workflow

author-issue

Shorthand: author-issue. Author a well-formed GitHub issue as the planner Technician, by consolidating durable evidence or shaping a new proposal from a durable decision, only with the Builder's explicit authorization in the current task. Check for duplicates read-only, resolve the repository's issue template or Garage's fallback, show the complete draft for confirmation, set only the approved title, body, and labels, and record the authoring role and source evidence. An authored issue never authorizes implementing it.
